campaign.title: Marketing campaigns
campaign.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this campaign?
campaign.name: Campaign name
campaign.recipientLimitHintOn: The total across the campaign's entire lifetime, not per year. A birthday campaign that hits the cap stops granting rewards in later years.
campaign.startDateMustStayPastWhileOpening: This campaign is open, so its start date must stay in the past. Moving it to the future silently stops the campaign from granting rewards.

template.title: Voucher
template.durationHintBirthday: How many days the voucher stays valid after a customer receives it. The campaign repeats every year; each customer receives it at most once a year.
template.durationHintNewUser: How many days the voucher stays valid after the customer registers.
template.durationHintWithEndDate: The voucher stays valid until the campaign ends.

campaign.confirmCreateDescription: Are you sure you want to create this campaign?
campaign.confirmUpdateDescription: Are you sure you want to update this campaign?
campaign.confirmCloseDescription: The campaign moves to Closed and stops granting rewards immediately.
campaign.closeNote1: Rewards already granted stay with customers.
campaign.closeNote2: You cannot reopen it from this screen.
campaign.rewardTypeHintVoucher: The customer receives a generated voucher code to use when ordering.
campaign.rewardTypeHintGift: The customer receives a gift. The reward type cannot be changed after the campaign is created.

giftTemplate.title: Gift name
giftTemplate.readOnlyNote: Gift details cannot be edited after creation — the backend does not support updating this yet.
giftTemplate.durationHintBirthday: How many days the gift stays valid after a customer receives it. The campaign repeats every year; each customer receives it at most once a year.
giftTemplate.durationHintNewUser: How many days the gift stays valid after the customer registers.
